payload.summary: PLAN_REVIEW iteration 0 is not_converged. The primary schema-valid review found one blocking correctness defect: the per-change advisory lock serializes different-sequence submit/reconcile transactions but cannot stop a stale submit that runs after reconciliation from recreating an active stale row. Two nonblocking plan gaps cover reconcile authorization-action ambiguity and a verification command that does not necessarily execute direct-MCP parity tests. The canonical multi-vendor dispatcher was stopped after Claude produced no result for more than five minutes; the remaining sequential vendors were not attempted, quorum is 0/4, and the degraded evidence is recorded without claiming vendor consensus.
completed_work: Reviewed proposal, design, tasks, specs, OpenAPI/SQL contracts, work-package DAG, and existing queue/API/MCP/CLI/bridge/autopilot seams.
Produced and schema-validated the primary five-finding plan review across correctness, security, observability, architecture, and resilience axes.
Dispatched the canonical provider-neutral multi-vendor reviewer, terminated it after the five-minute no-output health bound, and recorded exact timeout/unattempted outcomes in review-manifest.json.
Synthesized a degraded single-reviewer consensus artifact; its unconfirmed/accept labels do not override the independently source-verified critical finding.

decisions.title: Outcome is not_converged
decisions.rationale: The stated different-tuple race postcondition is false in one legal lock order. Reconcile(N) may commit and release the lock before delayed submit(N-1) acquires it and inserts a new pending row. A durable per-change authoritative-generation/high-water invariant or equivalent is required before implementation.

decisions.title: Vendor quorum is degraded, not silently satisfied
decisions.rationale: The dispatcher executes local CLI adapters sequentially and the first vendor emitted no result for over five minutes. It was terminated to preserve phase liveness; the other three vendors were never started. The manifest records quorum_received=0 and the consensus artifact marks all primary findings unconfirmed.

next_steps: PLAN_FIX must make different-sequence submit/reconcile behavior order-independent and add a forced reconcile-first/stale-submit-second PostgreSQL test.
Specify whether reconciliation reuses the existing submit_work policy action or widen package scope for a new Cedar/native action.
Add the direct MCP projection test module or a bounded encompassing test target to both coordinator verification gates.
After fixes, run strict OpenSpec, work-package, OpenAPI semantic, and PostgreSQL concurrency validations before the next PLAN_REVIEW round.
